meta.purpose: Titles and descriptions for Redbubble listings — Una Voce Dal Profondo
meta.project: Una Voce Dal Profondo — psychology and storytelling
meta.note: Divulgation project, not a shop. Redbubble handles sales and pays royalties on the illustrations. Keep the tone descriptive and poetic; avoid sales language (buy, shop now, discount).

collections.title: Mars
collections.description: Mars holds the fire of overwhelming emotion: the mood that flares without warning, the stress that storms, the exhaustion that quietly consumes. A collection about inner weather — and about learning to tend the flame instead of being burned by it.

collections.title: Mercury
collections.description: Mercury follows the mind that takes roads nobody has walked yet: letters that dance, numbers that slip away, hands that look for their own shape. A collection about learning differently — and finding in that difference a new kind of intelligence.

collections.title: Venus
collections.description: Venus explores the landscape of the self: the emotions that burn at full intensity, the distance that protects, the mirrors that ask for confirmation. A collection that looks at personality with a gentle eye — turning judgement into understanding.

collections.title: Earth
collections.description: Earth lives in the senses and in perception: bodies that remember, colours of sound, faces that slip away, gifts that shine beyond measure. A collection about the wonders of the human brain — and about perceiving the world as an extraordinary experience.

collections.title: Jupiter
collections.description: Jupiter grows large enough to hold every kind of difference: communication that changes shape, attention that runs ahead, a body that speaks before thought. A collection about neurodivergence in all its shades, to be welcomed with wonder and respect.

collections.title: Saturn
collections.description: Saturn follows the slow cycles of growth: minds that grow too fast, senses that feel too much, paths that cannot yet be chosen. A collection about neurodevelopment and its asynchronies — because every pace has its dignity.

collections.title: Uranus
collections.description: Uranus crosses the electrical storms of the nervous system: words that lose their way, pain that returns, lightning that shakes the body. A collection for those learning to live with the unexpected — and to find, every time, their own orbit again.

collections.title: Neptune
collections.description: Neptune dives into the depths of anxiety: waves of panic, worries without a name, silences that protect. A collection about the deepest water — and the shore that is always there, on the other side.

moons.title: Burnout
moons.tagline: Not weakness: holding on for too long.
moons.description: Burnout is the quiet aftermath of giving everything without pause. This design is for anyone learning that a flame is not protected by burning harder — it is protected by being tended, rested, and slowly rekindled.

moons.title: Stress
moons.tagline: Useful in small doses. Wearing when it never switches off.
moons.description: Stress is the inner weather that builds and builds until it asks for attention. This design is about the moment you stop fighting the storm and start listening to what it is trying to tell you.

moons.title: Dysthymia
moons.tagline: Not your personality: a condition that lasts for years.
moons.description: Dysthymia is a low, quiet grey that stays so long it starts to feel like the sky itself. This design is for the ones who have learned to walk under a rain nobody else can see.

moons.title: Depression
moons.tagline: You cannot will yourself out of it.
moons.description: Depression is a long night that takes the weight and the colour out of the world. This design walks through the dark without denying it — because even the deepest night has an edge you can reach.

moons.title: Bipolar Disorder
moons.tagline: Not ups and downs: clinical phases.
moons.description: Bipolar disorder lives between impossible heights and sudden depths. This design is about the art of navigating two lights at once — and learning your own rhythm before it becomes a storm.

moons.title: Anhedonia
moons.tagline: Not indifference: the loss of pleasure.
moons.description: Anhedonia is the ash that covers the fire: things keep happening, but nothing warms or interests you any more. This design is about the slow work of feeding the flame back to life, one small moment at a time.

moons.title: Dyslexia
moons.tagline: Thinking stays deep. Reading works differently.
moons.description: For a dyslexic mind, letters move and words take the long way round. This design celebrates a different route through language — one that is not slower, only differently drawn.

moons.title: Dyspraxia
moons.tagline: Coordination, not intelligence.
moons.description: Dyspraxia is about a body that takes its time to learn movements others take for granted. This design honours the patience of finding your own pace, step by step.

moons.title: Hyperlexia
moons.tagline: Reading early does not mean understanding everything.
moons.description: Hyperlexia is when reading comes early and meaning takes its time to catch up. This design is for the children who met words before words could explain themselves.

moons.title: Dyscalculia
moons.tagline: Numbers slip. It is not a measure of intelligence.
moons.description: Dyscalculia is when numbers stay a foreign language no matter how long you study them. This design is for everyone who has counted on their fingers long after they were told not to.

moons.title: Dysgraphia
moons.tagline: The idea is clear. The handwriting is the hard part.
moons.description: Dysgraphia is the gap between what the mind has written and what the hand can put on paper. This design is about the shape a thought takes when the road to the page is longer than usual.

moons.title: Dysorthography
moons.tagline: The thought is clear. Spelling is what fails.
moons.description: Dysorthography is about spelling that keeps wandering off the expected path. This design is for everyone who has rewritten the same word a dozen times and still made it their own.

moons.title: Avoidant Personality Disorder
moons.tagline: Not shyness: fear of rejection that makes you avoid.
moons.description: Avoidant personality disorder turns distance into a form of safety. This design is about the longing underneath the withdrawal — and the courage it takes to let someone closer.

moons.title: Antisocial Personality Disorder
moons.tagline: Not cruelty: a serious clinical condition.
moons.description: Antisocial personality disorder is a different relationship with rules, boundaries and other people. This design looks at it without easy judgement — as something to understand rather than to label.

moons.title: Paranoid Personality Disorder
moons.tagline: Not suspicion: a lens that never comes off.
moons.description: Paranoid personality disorder is a guard that never lowers its weapon. This design is about the exhaustion of always watching — and the relief of one moment of trust.

moons.title: Borderline Personality Disorder
moons.tagline: Not being too much: clinical instability.
moons.description: Borderline personality disorder is emotion at full volume, all of the time. This design honours the intensity beneath it — the depth of feeling that also makes love, colour and closeness possible.

moons.title: Narcissistic Personality Disorder
moons.tagline: Not vanity: fragile self-esteem.
moons.description: Narcissistic personality disorder is a mirror that keeps asking to be confirmed. This design looks past the reflection to the fragile thing that built it.

moons.title: Histrionic Personality Disorder
moons.tagline: Not making scenes: a stable way of being in relationships.
moons.description: Histrionic personality disorder is a portrait that needs a mirror to feel complete. This design is about being seen — and about the person behind the performance.

moons.title: Phantom Limb
moons.tagline: The brain keeps the map of what is no longer there.
moons.description: A phantom limb is the body remembering what is no longer there. This design is about a memory that lives in the nervous system — proof that the map of us is larger than our outline.

moons.title: Hyperthymesia
moons.tagline: An archive that never switches off.
moons.description: Hyperthymesia is an autobiographical memory that keeps every day in full detail. This design is about time that does not fade — and the weight and the beauty of remembering everything.

moons.title: Prosopagnosia
moons.tagline: Faces arrive without their names.
moons.description: Prosopagnosia, or face blindness, is a world where faces do not come with names attached. This design is about recognising people in other ways — voice, step, presence.

moons.title: Savant Syndrome
moons.tagline: An extraordinary gift, inside a whole person.
moons.description: Savant syndrome is an extraordinary ability living alongside a very different mind. This design celebrates the gift that shines out of all proportion — and the whole person around it.

moons.title: Synaesthesia
moons.tagline: Senses cross over: numbers have a colour.
moons.description: Synaesthesia is a world where sounds have colours, numbers have personalities and words have taste. This design is for those who experience more than one sense at once.

moons.title: Aphantasia
moons.tagline: Close your eyes and see nothing. Imagination stays.
moons.description: Aphantasia is a mind with no inner screen — imagining without seeing. This design is about a different way of thinking, remembering and dreaming.

moons.title: Autism Level 1
moons.tagline: The level describes the support needed, not the person.
moons.description: Autism Level 1 is a mind that receives the world at full volume and reads it in its own language. This design is for the daily work of translating yourself to others.

moons.title: Autism Level 2
moons.tagline: Substantial support, not generic patience.
moons.description: Autism Level 2 is a deep need for clarity in a world that rarely offers any. This design honours the effort of navigating noise, change and mixed signals all day long.

moons.title: Autism Level 3
moons.tagline: Very substantial support. The presence stays whole.
moons.description: Autism Level 3 is communication that travels on roads other than speech. This design is about being understood without words — and about the people who learn to listen there.

moons.title: Tourette Syndrome
moons.tagline: Tics are not a choice.
moons.description: Tourette syndrome is a body that speaks before the mind has time to. This design is about tics, words and movements that arrive uninvited — and the person who lives with them.

moons.title: ADHD
moons.tagline: Not laziness: a different way of setting priorities.
moons.description: ADHD is an attention that moves, jumps and connects things others keep apart. This design is for the energy that is not a fault — only a different engine.

moons.title: Alexithymia
moons.tagline: The emotions are there. The words are missing.
moons.description: Alexithymia is feeling everything and still not knowing what to call it. This design is about emotions that arrive before their name does.

moons.title: Multipotentiality
moons.tagline: Not a lack of focus: a way of being.
moons.description: A multipotentialite has too many passions to choose just one. This design is for those who have been told to specialise — and instead kept every road open.

moons.title: Highly Sensitive Person
moons.tagline: Not a disorder: a studied trait.
moons.description: A highly sensitive person feels the world with the skin of their soul: noise, light, moods, everything lands deeper. This design honours sensitivity as a way of being, not a flaw.

moons.title: Giftedness
moons.tagline: It is not just about getting good grades.
moons.description: Giftedness is a mind that needs wider horizons than the ones it is offered. This design is about intensity, depth and the hunger for something larger.

moons.title: Asynchronous Development
moons.tagline: Not inconsistency: different timings.
moons.description: Asynchronous development is growing at several speeds at once — a young mind in an older head, a tender heart in a fast brain. This design is about not matching the calendar.

moons.title: Sensory Hyperreactivity
moons.tagline: Not overreacting: a different nervous system.
moons.description: Sensory hyperreactivity is the world arriving at full volume: lights, textures, sounds, everything amplified. This design is for those who feel more, and earlier, than the room around them.

moons.title: Twice Exceptionality
moons.tagline: Talent hides the struggle. The struggle hides the talent.
moons.description: Twice exceptionality is a gifted mind and a learning difficulty sharing the same orbit. This design is for those who have been called brilliant and struggling in the same week.

moons.title: Aphasia
moons.tagline: Intelligence stays intact. Words are missing.
moons.description: Aphasia is when the thought is there but the words cannot find their way out. This design is about speaking in other forms — gesture, gaze, presence.

moons.title: Chronic Migraine
moons.tagline: Not just a headache.
moons.description: Chronic migraine is a pain that keeps coming back and rearranges the whole week around itself. This design is about learning your limits the hard way — and respecting them.

moons.title: Epilepsy
moons.tagline: Seizures recur. Medication controls them for most people.
moons.description: Epilepsy is an electrical storm crossing the brain without warning. This design is about living with a sky that can change suddenly — and still planning for tomorrow.

moons.title: Parkinson’s Disease
moons.tagline: Movement slows down. The person does not.
moons.description: Parkinson’s disease slows the gesture without slowing the person inside it. This design is about patience, dignity and the long distance a small movement can travel.

moons.title: Multiple Sclerosis
moons.tagline: Symptoms vary. Treatments exist.
moons.description: Multiple sclerosis is a body that keeps redrawing its own maps. This design is about navigating a landscape that changes — and still finding a route through it.

moons.title: ALS
moons.tagline: Mind and senses stay intact. Movement decreases.
moons.description: ALS, or motor neurone disease, is movement slowly falling silent while the person stays fully present. This design is a tribute to that presence — and to those who stay close.

moons.title: Panic Attacks
moons.tagline: Terrifying. Not dangerous.
moons.description: A panic attack is a wave that arrives without warning and takes the whole body with it. This design is about learning that the wave always, always passes.

moons.title: Generalised Anxiety Disorder
moons.tagline: Not overthinking: anxiety that stays switched on.
moons.description: Generalised anxiety disorder is worry that never finds a place to rest. This design is for the minds that keep running scenarios long after the day is over.

moons.title: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
moons.tagline: Not a love of order: rituals against anxiety.
moons.description: OCD is a thought that repeats itself, looking for safety it never quite finds. This design is about the loop — and about the courage of stepping outside it.

moons.title: Social Anxiety Disorder
moons.tagline: Not shyness: fear of judgement.
moons.description: Social anxiety is a room where every gaze feels like a stage light. This design is about being seen — and slowly learning that the audience was never that harsh.

moons.title: Selective Mutism
moons.tagline: Not stubbornness: an anxiety block.
moons.description: Selective mutism is a silence that protects a voice that is very much alive. This design is for the words waiting just behind the door.

moons.title: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
moons.tagline: Not a bad reaction: the brain's response to trauma.
moons.description: PTSD is when the storm stays in the body long after the sky has cleared. This design is about memory that does not know the danger has passed — and about feeling safe again.
